Live source: Open-Meteo `data_spatial/meteofrance_arpege_world025/2026/11/02/1200Z/`.

- `manifests.json`: run metadata of the 12 UTC run.
- `grid.json`: dimensions measured from the OM `temperature_2m` child (721 x 1440); the extent is the one Open-Meteo states (BBOX -90, -180, 90, 179.75). Orientation was checked against HRDPS Continental: south to north from -180 gave a mean absolute 2 m temperature difference of 1.2 degrees C, north to south 5.3, from 0 degrees longitude 10.1.

Source data: Meteo-France via Open-Meteo.
